item.title: Delivering Under Fire — Third Party Payment Provider Integration for Bank Decommission
item.description: A major bank’s decommissioning of a legacy payment process left just six weeks to deliver a new integration with a payment solutions company. Outcomes: course-corrected the architecture, resolved release-blocking issues under pressure and kept the deployment on track without downtime.
